scheme_name: Organizing/ Participation in Exhibitions /Trade Fairs /Expo /Seminars /Investors Meets, etc
benefits_summary: Paid travel expenses (second‑class railway fare) and a daily allowance of ₹400 per person, together with an honorarium of ₹400 per day and a winter clothing allowance up to ₹3,500 for participating artisans/unit industrialists at exhibitions, trade fairs and related events.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
